**`DestructiveActionConfirmation.swift`** — a `.confirmDestructiveAction(...)` modifier for `release`/`withdraw`. Both are real, consequential, hard-to-walk-back actions (release re-notifies the whole pod; withdraw closes the request with no receipt) — unlike `accept`, which should fire on a single tap since hesitating there is the actual failure mode the app exists to prevent.
